flags.why: Kiều means invoking a deity or deceased spirit to possess a living person, rather than ordinary prayer for protection ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kiều)).
flags.fix: to invoke a deity or deceased spirit to possess a living person for questioning or supplication

flags.why: The example describes ordinary ancestor worship and does not demonstrate the spirit-invocation meaning of kiều ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kiều)).
flags.fix: Họ làm lễ kiều vong. = They performed a ritual to summon a deceased spirit.

flags.why: Lọi means to remain or be left over, rather than to exclude someone from a group ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/lọi)).
flags.fix: to remain; to be left over

flags.why: Chẳng lọi một ai incorrectly uses lọi as a verb meaning to omit someone ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/lọi)).
flags.fix: Tiêu hết tiền, chẳng lọi một đồng. = All the money was spent, with not a penny left.

flags.why: Lí thú describes something interesting or enjoyable and does not have the stated noun meaning of pleasure taken in an activity ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/lý_thú)).
